_comment: Manual queue for the DMA Jobs Discord agent. Jobs here are approved to post but NOT yet posted (Discord is firewalled from the cloud sandbox; posting happens via browser or the Apps Script relay). After a job is posted, move its entry into posted-jobs.json with the date.
_note: Two leads held for Michelle's call, not posted. (1) JARS Cannabis Junior Graphic Designer, a legitimate in-house Phoenix design job on the employer's own ATS, verified live 3 Sep 2026, but a cannabis retailer, 21-or-older, and posted since 16 Mar 2026. (2) Three Train Studios remote animation and video editing internships, verified live 9 Sep 2026 on the studio's own site, but unpaid (academic credit only), applications go to a gmail address, and the studio is explicitly faith-based and asks interns to share its mission. Michelle decides whether either belongs on an official college channel. (3) HydroGeoLogic (HGL) Video Production Intern, Phoenix, $20/hr rising to $27.50, up to 24 hrs/week, hybrid, Adobe Premiere and After Effects, June 2026 through Feb 2027. Level and pay are close to ideal, but HGL's own careers page routes to an ATS whose direct requisition URL could not be found on 14 Sept 2026, so there is no verifiable company apply link and it was held rather than posted. (4) Two partisan political internships surfaced on 14 Sept 2026, Middle Seat Graphic Design Intern (Fall 2026, remote or DC, $20/hr, on the firm's own Workable board) and Turning Point Action Youth-Driven Graphic Design Intern (Phoenix). Both are real design roles on employer-owned boards, but they are advocacy organizations on opposite ends, and whether partisan employers belong on an official college channel is Michelle's call, not the agent's. (5) Re-checked 16 Sept 2026: HGL still has no reachable requisition URL from its own careers page, so it stays held. Also dropped that day, Sunland Asphalt Marketing Intern (Videographer and Editor), Phoenix, which appears only on LinkedIn and is not on Sunland's own ApplicantPro board, and the MLB Arizona Fall League Photographer/Videographer, Phoenix, which is now closed.
